long-term-mindset.note: Ten-year standalone history and continuing-operations reconstruction used; FY25 Hotels demerger gain excluded from operating trend.
long-term-mindset.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, PDF pp.253, 346-347

qual-and-quant.note: Audited statements were combined with customer, distribution, segment, regulation, management and moat evidence.

understand-business.note: Business and segment economics are mapped, but independent customer, competitor and peer validation remains incomplete.
understand-business.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, PDF pp.3-12, 69-87, 325

annual-report-primary.note: FY26 Report and Accounts is the primary source.

mda-review.note: Management claims, risks, segment performance and outlook reviewed separately from audited facts.
mda-review.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, PDF pp.64-113

consolidated-default.note: Consolidated statements used for core metrics; standalone ten-year data used only as supplementary history.
consolidated-default.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, PDF pp.252-258, 346-347

roe-debt.note: Returns remain strong and the group retains large liquid investments; gross borrowings rose but do not create net leverage.
roe-debt.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, PDF p.252

working-capital.note: Inventory and biological assets absorbed ₹3,306 crore in FY26; driver and normalisation need monitoring.
working-capital.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, PDF p.256

ratio-context.note: Segment mix makes generic peer comparison misleading; cigarette profit concentration and demerger-adjusted trends require context.
ratio-context.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, PDF pp.253, 325

valuation-after-quality.note: A dated market reference was reviewed only after business quality; valuation remains sensitive to cigarette regulation and sum-of-parts assumptions.
valuation-after-quality.source: Value Research, 27 July 2026; ITC FY26 EPS

valuation-caution.note: Valuation is treated as a range and current reference, not intrinsic-value precision.
